name: Mukul Dev
bio:
Mukul Dev (17 September 1970 – 23 May 2025) was an Indian television and film actor. He is known for his work in Hindi films, Punjabi films, TV series and music albums. He has also acted in few Bengali, Malayalam, Kannada and Telugu films. He received the 7th Amrish Puri Award, for excellence in acting for his role in Yamla Pagla Deewana.

He made his film debut in 1996 with Dastak as ACP Rohit Malhotra in the same movie which also introduced crowned Miss Universe Sushmita Sen. He appeared in several films such as Qila (1998), Wajood (1998), Kohram (1999) and Mujhe Meri Biwi Se Bachaao (2001). In recent years he has played supporting roles in films like Awara (2012), Son of Sardaar (2012), R... Rajkumar (2013), Jai Ho (2014), Bachchan (2014), Sultan: The Saviour (2018), and Saak (2019).
